scope: Framework-only upstream publication: ADR 0030 external-code boundary plus optional shared sampling controls

selected_cpu_suite.limits: CUDA/NCCL and custom Triton hardware cases skipped; vLLM engine tests use stubs.

known_limits: Concurrent NCCL publishers sharing a learner can fail with an unacknowledged source transfer; unresolved, with base64 available.
New sampling controls are supported for evaluation; transformed behavior/current-policy probabilities still require separate PPO/GRPO qualification.
Earlier hardware evidence qualifies its exact core; no new GPU, serving, multi-node or throughput qualification is inferred from local passes.
